commit.message:
Describe extension stages and name Extension Maintainers

README.md says what the stage directories mean, how Stable extensions are
versioned, and which Interest Group the extensions belong to.
MAINTAINERS.md uses the term Extension Maintainers from SEP-3392, so it is
not confused with the project's Core Maintainers. The people listed do not
change.

Move OAuth Client Credentials to stable

Move the specification from specification/draft/ to
specification/stable/oauth-client-credentials/2026-07-28/ and add a draft/
copy beside it. SEP-3392 classifies both ext-auth extensions as Stable.
The text is unchanged apart from the protocol revision in the Info line.

Publish Enterprise-Managed Authorization as a dated revision

Move the specification to
specification/stable/enterprise-managed-authorization/2026-07-28/ and add
a draft/ copy beside it, the layout SEP-3392 describes for a Stable
extension. The text is unchanged apart from the Info line, which now
states the protocol revision.

commit.message:
Align Enterprise-Managed Authorization with id-jag-04

Reduce duplication by referencing draft-ietf-oauth-identity-assertion-authz-grant-04
for roles, token exchange parameters, ID-JAG claims, and processing rules,
keeping only MCP-specific constraints inline.

- Adopt 'Resource Authorization Server' terminology from id-jag §2
- Replace parameter/claim tables with section references plus MCP deltas
- Keep `resource` REQUIRED in this profile (id-jag-04 made it optional)
- Drop the restriction on `actor_token` (removed upstream in -03)
- Replace multi-tenant implementation notes with reference to id-jag §6
- Reference id-jag §5 for cross-domain client_id handling
- Add Discovery section referencing `authorization_grant_profiles_supported`
